_goal: error_ceiling: 0. Every number below is debt to pay down, not budget to spend. Ceilings may only decrease; raising one requires a 'Ceiling-Approval:' commit trailer (drc_ratchet.detect_ceiling_raise).

_march.2026-07-27: error_ceiling 158 -> 90. The 158 was set when the board measured 158; the domain-clearance re-solve cut actual errors to 90 and nobody ratcheted, leaving 68 errors of slack for a regression to hide in. violations_by_type is now populated AND enforced -- a category absent from it has an implicit ceiling of 0, so a new violation class cannot arrive for free under the aggregate.

_march.2026-07-28-routed-rebaseline: RE-BASELINED against the routed board on the owner's explicit instruction. 556ccf4f committed the first route (51 of 96 nets), so the board now carries 2338 track segments and 48 vias; the previous ceilings (85 errors / 578 warnings) were measured on an UNROUTED board, so the gate was comparing two different artifacts. Errors 85 -> 736, warnings 578 -> 762. Measured through the gate's own run_drc path over 8 samples, NOT a raw kicad-cli call -- the two disagree because the gate fills zones first. Found while doing this: clearance and shorting_items are NON-DETERMINISTIC on an unchanged board (clearance 334-343, shorting_items 148-174 over 8 runs). Their ceilings are observed maxima and are NOT ratchetable until that is fixed; the other 9 error types were identical on every run and are. Warnings were stable at 762 on all 8 runs. _goal remains error_ceiling 0.
_march.2026-07-28-determinism-fix: DRC made reproducible. kicad-cli reports only a SUBSET of errors per track unless --all-track-errors is passed, and which subset it picks varied run-to-run on a byte-identical board: clearance 334-343, shorting_items 148-174, tracks_crossing 2-3 over 11 runs. The flag is now passed by _drc_api.run_drc. Residual variance is clearance alone at +/-1 over 5 runs; everything else is stable. Counts ROSE because the old figures were a sample, not a measurement -- clearance 337 -> 499, shorting_items ~160 -> 199, hole_clearance 24 -> 120. 499 is the clearance count STRATEGY.md already records independently for this board, which is corroboration that the higher number is the true one. Ceilings re-measured accordingly: errors 783 -> 1017, warnings 762 (unchanged, always stable). This is a reporting correction, not a regression: the board did not change, the measurement stopped undercounting. _goal remains error_ceiling 0, and per-type ratcheting is now actually possible.
_march.2026-07-28-provenance-source-typo-fix: check_measurement_provenance.py's gate went from invisible (masked behind the then-failing Evidence provenance gate, fixed by PR #383) to failing: 'malformed provenance: source=measured-live-5-samples must be one of (measured-live, backfilled-historical)'. Root cause: the 2026-07-28-routed-rebaseline and 2026-07-28-determinism-fix entries above each invented a non-schema 'source' value (measured-live-8-samples, then measured-live-5-samples) to fold the sample count into that field, instead of using the fixed two-value enum scripts/_lib/measurement_provenance.py documents and validates. This is a metadata-schema bug, not a staleness bug -- the recorded input hash (815512088f...098ef1) still matches pcb/temper.kicad_pcb's current content exactly (verified: 'shasum -a 256 pcb/temper.kicad_pcb' at HEAD 34132799), so no re-derivation of the ceiling was needed or performed. Fixed by setting source back to the documented 'measured-live' value; the sample count it was carrying is not lost -- it was already duplicated in measured_via's prose and in nondeterministic_error_types.clearance.samples, so measured_via now says so explicitly. error_ceiling, warning_ceiling, and violations_by_type are untouched.
_march.2026-07-29-category-source-schema: Added the 'category_source' field below -- schema only, no ceiling value touched (error_ceiling, warning_ceiling, violations_by_type, warnings_by_type are all byte-identical to the prior entry; see git diff). violations_by_type and warnings_by_type are both measured_via kicad-cli (per provenance above) -- but kicad-cli and temper_drc_rs (the 'rust' DrcRatchet backend) are two different engines with overlapping-looking rule names (e.g. temper_drc_rs reports a 'creepage' check_name that is not a KiCad DRC violation type at all; bare kicad-cli never emits it). Nothing previously said, in the file itself, which engine these specific counts came from. drc_ratchet.py's DrcCeilingEntry now reads this field and the ratchet's own output now names the source per category block, so a reader never has to guess or cross-reference code to know which engine measured a given number.
_march.2026-07-29-tank-cap-remeasure: check_measurement_provenance.py correctly reported this record STALE: PR #413's tank-capacitor-tolerance work included 81385272 ('place the corrected tank capacitors; board now matches its netlist'), which changed pcb/temper.kicad_pcb's content (815512088f...098ef1 -> 9f2cdb7d9088cc125d555bd3ceee217e386a2e08b74a2466dd5c566d27d02248, see provenance.inputs below) after the prior entry's measurement. Re-measured for real, not re-stamped: 120 samples of temper_placer.validation._drc_api.run_drc (kicad-cli 10.0.4, --all-track-errors) against the current checked-in board (unchanged structurally -- still 168 footprints / 2338 segments / 48 vias / 96 zones per a raw grep of the file, so this is a placement-only delta). Warnings are fully deterministic across all 120 runs and byte-identical to the prior record (762 total, same 10-category breakdown) -- untouched. Errors: 8 of 11 categories are exactly as before (annular_width 4, copper_edge_clearance 15, courtyards_overlap 11, drill_out_of_range 4, hole_to_hole 1, solder_mask_bridge 154, tracks_crossing 3, via_diameter 4). clearance reproduces the prior record's own observed range (499-501 over 120 runs; ceiling 502 = max+1 headroom, unchanged in value). Two categories the prior record treated as deterministic are NOT, on this board: hole_clearance varies 115-120 (120 in 116/120 runs, occasional dips) and shorting_items varies 199-200 (200 in 2/120 runs) -- neither ever exceeded the new ceilings below in 120 samples. This was not visible before either because the prior board didn't have this variance or because 5-8 samples were too few to catch a ~2% event; it cannot be distinguished from history, so it is recorded as newly-observed rather than claimed as new. Ceilings for both follow the existing clearance precedent (observed max + 1 headroom): hole_clearance 120 -> 121, shorting_items 199 -> 201. error_ceiling 1017 -> 1020 (+3, entirely the two new headroom counts; clearance's own ceiling did not move). This raises the aggregate, so it carries a Ceiling-Approval trailer on the commit that lands it -- the raise is measured headroom for confirmed run-to-run noise, not a swept-under regression, but the ratchet's own stated rule (top of this file) is commit-trailer-gated regardless of reason. warning_ceiling and warnings_by_type are untouched. provenance below is a fresh measured-live record, not backfilled.
